features.rationale: Turn the main cylinder and projecting spigot, including the end lead-in and the centered annular groove, as one axial profile.
features.justification: Origin is the left spigot end. The .250 dimension locates the groove center from the main-body shoulder; .062 CENT. places the groove-bottom boundaries symmetrically about that center. Both flanks are the indicated 30° TYP. The numerical coefficients 0.5773502691896258 and 1.7320508075688772 are tan(30°) and cot(30°), respectively, derived from the printed D008 and D009 angles, not independent dimensions. The .094 dimension is the axial lead-in length. Nominal diameters are modeled; the MAX shoulder blend is deferred separately.

features.rationale: Represent the specified axial internal thread cosmetically using its standard tap-drill diameter over the specified tapped length.
features.justification: A #10-32 UNF thread (D012 nominal major diameter) conventionally uses a #21 drill, diameter .159 inch, from the Unified thread tap-drill chart. Crossed centerlines establish the hole at the part axis. D013 specifies the tapped length only: this feature represents that guaranteed threaded envelope with a flat bottom, not an inferred extra drilling depth or drill point. No thread fit class is assumed.

features.rationale: What full-diameter drilling depth beyond the specified tapped length is required? The drawing does not dimension it.
features.justification: The .159 diameter is the standard #21 tap drill for #10-32 UNF. D013 is expressly tapped depth, not a separately stated drill depth; no additional drill travel is invented.

notes: Dimensions in inches. General tolerances: two-place ±.020, three-place ±.010, angles ±1°. Spigot diameter specifically +.000/-.002.
D014, D015, and D016 are derived quantities, not additional controlling dimensions; the profile uses their source D-IDs directly.

STAMP—"SB-12009" is a manufacturing marking instruction on the main cylindrical body. Text stamping is outside the available geometric IR; character size, depth, orientation, and exact location are unspecified. No invented marking geometry is included.
The unresolved MAX-radius feature must not be applied at D010 without approval. The planned profile retains a sharp shoulder pending that decision.
The blind-hole drill point is cosmetic and is not modeled. Additional full-diameter drilling depth, unlike drill-point shape, is not established by this tapped-depth callout.
